back.es: his (also hers, theirs, yours formal): the possessive pronoun after ser, masculine singular
back.example: That car isn't mine, it's his (or hers, theirs, yours).

note: The hint's "one word" correctly rules out the very common Latin American "de él"; the editor might mention that suyo agrees with the thing owned (suya, suyos, suyas), since grammar is null for pronouns.
